description: Create an unsent draft: a new message, or a reply when reply_to is given (reply rules and reply-all apply). Nothing is sent until send_draft; delete_draft discards it. The draft is visible in the user's other fmsg clients. Secrets in the body and topic are redacted.

allow_no_reply.description: draft a reply even though the parent asked for no replies

content_type.description: inferred from the filename when omitted

data_base64.description: base64 file contents, for small files. The host sets the size limit

data_text.description: text file contents, sent as UTF-8 bytes; use instead of data_base64 for text

sha256.description: hex sha256 of the file; the attachment is refused, and nothing sent, if the bytes differ. Give it when you can compute it

body.description: message body; Markdown unless type says otherwise

no_reply.description: ask recipients (and their agents) not to reply

to.description: recipient addresses (@user@domain) or short names; for a reply, overrides reply-all

topic.description: thread topic for a new message; not allowed with reply_to

name: create_draft

attachments.description: sorted by filename, the same order in every tool

type.description: media type; inferred from the filename when the host records none

hint.description: for you, not the user: a better way to do this next time

redacted.description: the kinds of secret replaced; empty when none

redactions.description: secrets replaced with placeholders in the draft

resolved.description: short names and how they resolved, when any were given; confirm with the user if an address looks wrong

upload.description: where to upload more attachments; present when this server has a public URL

accepts_encoding.description: Content-Encoding values accepted; the server decodes them before storing

authentication.description: one of "bearer"; bearer: send this MCP connection's Authorization header. More values may be added

checksum_header.description: optional request header carrying the file's hex sha256; a mismatch is refused and the file not kept

method.description: one of "PUT". More values may be added

url_template.description: replace {filename} with the attachment's file name (letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen)

warnings.description: things to tell the user, such as redacted secrets or resolved short names

title: Create fmsg draft
